note: the effort-* agents are now provided by the agent-board plugin; plain `claude` sessions outside agent-board lose them once they are gone from ~/.claude/agents. Use --keep-agents to leave them in place.
next: a running tmux server still has the old hooks and keys. Either restart tmux, or run
  tmux set-hook -gu after-split-window; tmux set-hook -gu session-closed; tmux unbind W; tmux unbind f; tmux unbind D
With the lines gone from ~/.tmux.conf, the next `agent-board dev` starts on agent-board's dedicated tmux server (-L agent-board).
